definitions.explanation: The act of paying money, often used as a suffix to indicate a payment method or timing.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}は{月末|げつまつ}{払|ばら}いです。
examples.english: Salaries are paid at the end of the month.

examples.japanese: {現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}いでお{願|ねが}いします。
{分割|ぶんかつ}{払|ばら}いは{可能|かのう}ですか。

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{月末|げつまつ}{払|ばら}い (end-of-month payment)
・{現金|げんきん}{払|ばら}い (cash payment)
・{分割|ぶんかつ}{払|ばら}い (installment payment)
・カード{払|ばら}い (card payment)
・{一括|いっかつ}{払|ばら}い (lump-sum payment)
・{後|あと}{払|ばら}い (deferred payment)

RELATED:
・{払|はら}う (to pay - verb)
・{支払|しはら}い (payment - more formal)
